name: Faction Reputation System
playerFacingEffect: Factions react to your actions; reputation unlocks discounts, allies, and quest branches.
stateChanges: Add state.factions (rep map, flags) and extend shop/title/quest logic to read rep thresholds.
dataChanges: Add a faction registry (id, tiers, perks) and optional rep hooks on quests and shop items.
testPlan: Unit tests: rep deltas clamp correctly; thresholds unlock perks once; deterministic quest weighting with rep.

name: Injury / Wounds System
playerFacingEffect: Dropping to low HP can cause lingering wounds that persist across fights until treated.
stateChanges: Add player.wounds[] with severity, tags, and treatment requirements; hook into combat damage + rest.
dataChanges: Add wound templates (bleeding, fracture, curse scar) and treatment items/services.
testPlan: Unit tests: wound application thresholds; treatment removes tags; wounds survive save/load.

name: Weather and Hazards System
playerFacingEffect: Weather shifts by region and time, modifying accuracy, stealth, and elemental effects.
stateChanges: Add world.weather { kind, intensity, expiresAt } and feed modifiers into combat calculations.
dataChanges: Add biome->weather tables and hazard hooks (e.g., ash storm amplifies burn).
testPlan: Unit tests: seeded weather sequences; modifiers applied consistently; hazards expire correctly.

name: Profession Recipe Book System
playerFacingEffect: Professions unlock recipes, letting players craft items and upgrades deterministically.
stateChanges: Add player.recipesKnown[] and profession XP tracking; crafting consumes materials from inventory.
dataChanges: Add recipe definitions (inputs, outputs, tier requirements) tied to ProfessionRegistry.
testPlan: Unit tests: crafting consumes correct quantities; recipe gating by tier; deterministic output where required.

name: Companion Bond System
playerFacingEffect: Companions gain bond levels, unlocking support actions and passive buffs.
stateChanges: Add player.companions[] with bond, traits, cooldowns; integrate companion turns in combat loop.
dataChanges: Add companion templates and bond perk tables; optional quest hooks for recruitment.
testPlan: Unit tests: bond gain determinism; companion action legality; combat integration does not mutate state in place.

name: Resistances and Afflictions System
playerFacingEffect: Race traits, gear, and titles provide typed resistances that reduce DOT/control duration.
stateChanges: Add derived resist map on player/enemies (computed) and apply in EffectApplicationSystem.
dataChanges: Standardize resistance tags across races/items/titles; add a small resistance registry if needed.
testPlan: Unit tests: resistance clamps; stacking rules; deterministic application order across multiple effects.

name: Procedural Encounter System
playerFacingEffect: Exploration spawns seeded encounters by biome, time, and player profile.
stateChanges: Add world.encounterSeed and encounterHistory; integrate with ExplorationSystem travel actions.
dataChanges: Add encounter tables keyed by biome and tags (favored classes/races).
testPlan: Unit tests: same seed yields same encounter chain; encounter tables filter correctly; safe fallback when empty.

name: Run Event Sourcing System
playerFacingEffect: Runs can be replayed: a deterministic event log and snapshots are stored server-side.
stateChanges: Add runId, seq counters, and snapshot cadence; emit run events from reducer/system observer.
dataChanges: Use dbo.game_runs / dbo.game_run_events / dbo.game_run_snapshots for persistence.
testPlan: Unit tests: seq monotonicity; snapshot cadence; serialization is stable and JSON-valid.

name: Achievement and Titles Expansion
playerFacingEffect: Achievements grant titles and cosmetic markers; progress is visible and shareable.
stateChanges: Add player.achievements (progress map) and hook into SystemEventObserver.
dataChanges: Extend titleData with achievement conditions; add achievement definitions if separated.
testPlan: Unit tests: unlock conditions; idempotent unlock; equipping title updates derived bonuses deterministically.

name: Equipment Durability System
playerFacingEffect: Equipment loses durability on use; broken gear disables its stats until repaired.
stateChanges: Add durability to inventory/equipment items; integrate with combat and shop repair service.
dataChanges: Define durability defaults per item type and add repair pricing rules.
testPlan: Unit tests: durability ticks on expected events; break disables stats; repair restores and charges currency.

name: Skill Loadouts System
playerFacingEffect: Players can save/load skill loadouts; combat hotbar stays consistent across sessions.
stateChanges: Add player.loadouts[] and activeLoadoutId; validate skill legality on swap.
dataChanges: No new data required; optional UI additions for management.
testPlan: Unit tests: swapping preserves cooldown policy; illegal skills are filtered; loadouts persist in saved state.

name: Enemy Intent Telegraph System
playerFacingEffect: Enemies telegraph next actions; stealth/control can disrupt their intent.
stateChanges: Add combat.enemyIntents[] derived per enemy; update each turn with deterministic RNG.
dataChanges: Optional: add intent weights to enemy templates/skills.
testPlan: Unit tests: same seed yields same intent; disruption rules; intent clears when enemy dies.

name: Dynamic Economy System
playerFacingEffect: Prices fluctuate by district, scarcity, and player reputation; hoarding has consequences.
stateChanges: Add world.economy (price multipliers, stock) and player.marketFlags.
dataChanges: Add baseline price rules and scarcity tags on items.
testPlan: Unit tests: price calc deterministic; stock clamps; discounts stack in correct order.

name: Seasons + Time Expansion
playerFacingEffect: Seasons change available encounters, shop stock, and elemental balance.
stateChanges: Extend world.time with season and day counters; integrate with Weather/Encounter systems.
dataChanges: Add season tables per biome and seasonal modifiers for loot/encounters.
testPlan: Unit tests: season advancement schedule; modifiers applied; no drift across save/load.

name: City Heat / Crime System
playerFacingEffect: Illegal actions raise heat; guards spawn, prices rise, and access closes until you cool down.
stateChanges: Add world.heat by district; integrate with stealth actions and shop access rules.
dataChanges: Add district heat thresholds and guard encounter tables.
testPlan: Unit tests: heat thresholds; deterministic guard triggers; cooldown over time.

name: Nemesis Evolving Enemy System
playerFacingEffect: A recurring enemy adapts to your build, gaining counters and unique drops over time.
stateChanges: Add player.nemesis { id, adaptations, encounters } and hook into combat end events.
dataChanges: Add adaptation tables (by damage types/effects) and nemesis reward items.
testPlan: Unit tests: evolution determinism; adaptation selection; nemesis persistence across saves.

name: Outpost / Settlement System
playerFacingEffect: Build an outpost that grants buffs, crafting options, and safe travel routes.
stateChanges: Add world.outposts[] with upgrades and upkeep; integrate with travel and crafting.
dataChanges: Add outpost upgrade definitions and material costs.
testPlan: Unit tests: upgrade requirements; upkeep tick; deterministic buffs by outpost level.

name: Ritual Casting System
playerFacingEffect: Multi-turn rituals trade safety for power, enabling large buffs, summons, or world changes.
stateChanges: Add combat.ritual (stage, remaining, costs) and world.ritualsCompleted for unlocks.
dataChanges: Add ritual definitions (stages, costs, rewards) and item catalysts.
testPlan: Unit tests: stage progression; interruption behavior; deterministic outcomes from seeded inputs.

name: Narrative Memory + Tagging System
playerFacingEffect: Narrative entries are tagged (biome, faction, threat) and summarized for recall and UI search.
stateChanges: Extend state.narrative with tags/index; integrate with prompt assembly without generating prose in systems.
dataChanges: No required data; optional tag taxonomy registry for consistency.
testPlan: Unit tests: tag inference from events; summary refresh cadence; stable output for same inputs.

name: Relic Attunement System
playerFacingEffect: Legendary items unlock their unique passive gradually as you attune them through use.
stateChanges: Add item.attunement { level, xp } for equipped uniques; hook into combat and quest completions.
dataChanges: Add attunement curves and optional attunement quests for specific relics.
testPlan: Unit tests: attunement XP gain sources; level thresholds; passive unlock toggles.
